title: 第5章 神秘的烟雨阁第6章 没错就是明抢
slug: 我纨绔世子开局征服太子妃
content_zh:
这一刻，雪月楼内，死寂无声。
空气中弥漫的血腥味浓郁得令人作呕，
所有人都瞪大眼睛看着那四颗头颅，全都傻眼了，有的心理素质差的更是当场就‘哇’的一声呕吐了起来。
咚！
咚！
咚！
这时一阵急促而沉重的脚步声从雪月楼外传来，
转眼间，一队身穿玄色制服、腰佩制式长刀的武者冲了进来，为首之人气息沉凝，赫然是一位六品武者。
他们制服的胸口，都绣着一个威严的“皇”
字。
皇城司！
京城秩序的守护者！
为首的皇城司队长一眼就看到了地上的四颗头颅，瞳孔骤然一缩。
他的脸色瞬间变得无比难看，这四张脸他都认得，他们的父亲，无一不是朝中有权有势的官员。
四位官宦子弟被当众斩首，这事要是处理不好，他这个队长也就当到头了！
他目光如电，瞬间锁定了一身煞气未散的冷月，猛地拔刀出鞘，刀锋直指，厉声喝道：“大胆狂徒！
竟敢在天子脚下行凶！
来人，给我就地拿下！”
“锵！
锵！

锵！”
他身后的皇城司成员齐刷刷拔刀，冰冷的刀锋在灯火下反射出森然寒光，瞬间将青鸟围在中央。
就在这剑拔弩张之际，一道懒洋洋的声音不合时宜地响起。
“皇城司？好大的官威。”
楚风慢悠悠地来到那群皇城司之人面前，冷道：“连我镇北王府的人都敢抓，怎么？当我镇北王府没人了么？”
唰！
直到此刻，那皇城司队长和一众手下才注意到一旁的楚风，一个个脸色都是一变。
这位镇北世子，可是京城里无法无天的代名词，他们皇城司可没少跟他打交道，每次都弄得灰头土脸。
那队长的脸色变了又变，最终还是缓缓收刀入鞘，对着楚风拱了拱手，语气生硬地说道：“原来是楚世子在此，卑职眼拙，还请世子见谅。”
“现在，你还要带走我的人吗？”
楚风瞥了他一眼，淡淡问道。
队长头皮一阵发麻，硬着头皮道：“楚世子，您的人当众斩杀四人，人证物证俱在。
我等奉命维持京城法纪，理应将凶手缉拿归案。”
“况且，这四位公子的身世背景……我们若是不管，实在无法交代。”
“交代？”

content_en:
At this moment, there was deathly silence in Xueyue Tower.
The smell of blood in the air was so strong that it was nauseating.
Everyone looked at the four heads with their eyes wide open, and they were all dumbfounded. Some of them with poor psychological quality even vomited on the spot with a "wow" sound.
Boom!
Boom!
Boom!
At this time, a burst of rapid and heavy footsteps came from outside Xueyue Tower.
In the blink of an eye, a group of warriors wearing black uniforms and standard long swords rushed in. The leader had a calm aura and was clearly a sixth-grade warrior.
The chests of their uniforms all have a majestic "Emperor" embroidered on them.
words.
Imperial City Division!
The guardian of order in the capital!
The leader of the Imperial City Division saw the four heads on the ground at a glance, and his pupils suddenly shrank.
His expression instantly became extremely ugly. He recognized all four faces. Their fathers were all powerful officials in the court.
Four officials' sons were beheaded in public. If this matter was not handled properly, he, the captain, would be doomed!
His eyes were like lightning, and he instantly locked onto Leng Yue, who was still full of evil spirits. He suddenly drew his sword out of its sheath, pointed the blade straight at it, and shouted sternly: "Bold maniac!
How dare you commit murder at the feet of the Emperor!
Come on, take it down for me on the spot! "
"Qiang!
Clang!
Clang! "
The members of the Imperial City Division behind him all drew their swords, and the cold blade reflected a cold light under the light, instantly surrounding the blue bird in the center.
Just at this tense moment, a lazy voice sounded at an inappropriate time.
"Imperial City Secretary? What a powerful official."
Chu Feng slowly came to the group of people from the Imperial City Department and said coldly: "You even dare to arrest people from my Zhenbei Palace. What? Do you think there is no one in my Zhenbei Palace?"
Uh-huh!
It was only at this moment that the captain of the Imperial City Division and his subordinates noticed Chu Feng beside them, and their expressions changed.
This Prince of Zhenbei was synonymous with lawlessness in the capital, and our Imperial City Department had to deal with him frequently, and every time he was disgraced.
The captain's expression changed again and again, but finally he slowly sheathed his sword, cupped his hands in front of Chu Feng, and said in a stiff tone: "It turns out that the Prince of Chu is here. He is humble and clumsy in his position. Please forgive me."
"Now, do you want to take away my people?"
Chu Feng glanced at him and asked lightly.
The captain's scalp felt numb for a while, and he said bravely: "Chu Shizi, your people killed four people in public, and there are both witnesses and physical evidence.
We are ordered to maintain law and order in the capital and should bring the murderer to justice. "
"Besides, the background of these four young masters...if we don't care about it, we really can't explain it."
"Explain?"
